A technical challenge we solved building Ultra-Dex:

**The Problem:**
Rerouting requests mid-stream when a provider fails

**What we tried:**
- Initially tried request queuing (too slow)
- Then tried pre-warming all providers (too expensive)

**The solution:**
Circuit breaker pattern + health checks every 30s + fallback chain

**Impact:**
99.9% uptime with 50ms failover

**Key lesson:**
Health checks matter more than retries

#AI #Startups
